answer: The oasis report exposes the merge explicitly at each pearl. The replay builds a funding-and-timing graph over every join and collapses clusters that share a funder, an address prefix, or suspiciously correlated submission times into a single entity. Each collapsed cluster gets one cipher weight, one vote, and one jury seat regardless of how many keys it holds. A 124 account operation therefore ties up 27 million dollars of idle capital. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
